column1: # Vendor issues someone has looked at. The vendor-limits watchdog
# (scripts/check-vendor-limits.mjs) still shows them in every run, as
# warnings, until the date given. A failing vendor row fails the run
# unless every failing cause in it is acknowledged here, within its
# ceiling and its date.
# One tab-separated line per cause:
#   vendor (exactly as the run table names it)
#   status (WARN|BREACH|ERROR)
#   cause_contains (text the cause must contain: the one you looked at.
#     Text that also matches another cause in the vendor's row, failing or
#     not, holds neither.)
#   up_to (the most you accept, in the cause's own unit: events, dollars,
#     commands. Write - only for a cause with no measured value, such as
#     an ERROR, a suspended database or a quota flag: a - line never holds
#     a measured cause, and a number never holds one without a value.)
#   acknowledged_until (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC, inclusive, at most 30 days out)
#   note
# Anything else fails the run again: another status, another cause for
# the same vendor, a value above the ceiling, a passed date. A line that
# matched nothing is flagged in the run so it gets deleted.
# Examples, not active (uncomment only for a cause you have looked at):
